title: Diagnostic Review: Customer Revenue Aggregation and Window Leakage
description: Review a high-volume relational aggregation query for mathematical errors, aggregation bias, and lookahead feature leakage.

artifact.content:
SELECT
    user_id,
    payment_method,
    COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(order_amount_inr) AS total_spend,
    SUM(order_amount_inr) / COUNT(order_id) AS avg_order_value,
    MAX(order_timestamp) OVER (
        PARTITION BY user_id
        ORDER BY order_timestamp
        ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS next_activity_timestamp,
    AVG(delivery_fee_inr) AS avg_delivery_fee
FROM customer_orders
WHERE order_status = 'DELIVERED'
  AND order_timestamp >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY user_id, payment_method
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;

defects.title: Unguarded Division in Average Order Value Calculation
defects.consequence: When a customer has zero matching orders, unguarded division yields runtime SQL zero division exceptions or silent NULL propagation.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Wrap the denominator with NULLIF(COUNT(order_id), 0) or use the native AVG aggregate function.

defects.title: Future Activity Window Lookahead Leakage
defects.consequence: Partitioning with UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING injects future event timestamps into historical feature records, causing fatal target leakage in downstream models.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Restrict window frames to historical data using ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.

defects.title: Extraneous Grouping Key in Customer Level Aggregation
defects.consequence: Including payment_method in the GROUP BY clause fragments customer metrics across payment instruments, producing multiple records per user instead of a single customer rollup.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Group strictly by user_id to compute true user-level metrics, or aggregate payment methods into an array.

instructions: Inspect the SQL query for relational pitfalls, unguarded mathematical operations, and predictive feature leakage. Flag flawed line numbers and select correct defect classifications.
